results.title: A faster way to manage version updates with Dependabot - The GitHub Blog
results.snippet: And given that some types of related dependencies must be updated together–such as with Storybook, Angular, and AWS SDK–it’s all too easy to put off these tasks until it’s too late. Today’s general availability release is all about making it easier to stay on top of version updates and prevent breaking changes. Previously, Dependabot would open individual pull requests for each update, adding overhead to a developer’s workflow and raising the possibility that related dependencies could fall out of sync.

results.snippet: Version 11.0.0 marks a major release of the Sentry JavaScript SDKs containing breaking changes. The goal of this release is to be better compatible with OpenTelemetry, make our integrations work across Node.js, Cloudflare, Bun and Deno through run-time and build-time instrumentation, and make span streaming and more permissive data collection the default. Please carefully read through the migration guide in the Sentry docs on how to upgrade from version 10 to version 11.
